specs.Compatible Devices: Laptops, Smartphones, Tablets, Gaming Consoles, Blu-ray Players, Media Streaming Devices

features: SCREEN SIZE: Transforms your home into a theater and projects up to a 254cm (100") screen for movies, TV, and gaming.
240° TILT MECHANISM: With its 240° tilt mechanism, the projector allows easy angle adjustments for better viewing comfort, helping to reduce glare and lessen neck and eye strain.
BRIGHTNESS: Equipped with a high-performance LED lamp producing 4000 lumens, it ensures bright visuals and impressive projection capability.
HIGH-RESOLUTION: Experience breathtaking clarity with 4K UHD support on large screens, offering sharp details and a truly immersive viewing experience.
BUILT-IN SPEAKER: Enjoy immersive sound during your movie marathons with a powerful built-in speaker. The projector also comes with a remote control for easy audio and video adjustments.
